LocalDate.name: Local Date
LocalDate.definition: Local date the transaction takes place at the card acceptor location.

LocalTime.name: Local Time
LocalTime.definition: Local time the transaction takes place at the card acceptor location.

TimeZone.name: Time Zone
TimeZone.definition: Time zone name (for example, as defined by IANA - Internet Assigned Numbers Authority - in the time zone database).

PurchaseIdentifierType.name: Purchase Identifier Type
PurchaseIdentifierType.definition: Specifies the type of identifier present in the message. P000-P999 reserved for private use, N000-N999 reserved for national use.

PurchaseIdentifier.name: Purchase Identifier
PurchaseIdentifier.definition: Contains a value identifying Invoice Data or Purchase Request Data.

TransmissionDateTime.name: Transmission Date Time
TransmissionDateTime.definition: Date and time expressed in UTC of the message as sent by the initiator.

SystemTraceAuditNumber.name: System Trace Audit Number
SystemTraceAuditNumber.definition: Number assigned by a transaction originator to assist in identifying a transaction uniquely. The trace number remains unchanged for all messages within a two-message exchange (for example, request/repeat and response).

RetrievalReferenceNumber.name: Retrieval Reference Number
RetrievalReferenceNumber.definition: Reference supplied by the system retaining the original source information and used to assist in locating that information or a copy thereof.

LifeCycleSupport.name: Life Cycle Support
LifeCycleSupport.definition: Indicate the point in the transaction lifecycle at which the lifecycle identifier was assigned.

AuthorisationSequenceNumber.name: Authorisation Sequence Number
AuthorisationSequenceNumber.definition: Contains authorisation sequence number. This is related transaction lifecycle data.

PresentmentSequenceNumber.name: Presentment Sequence Number
PresentmentSequenceNumber.definition: Number used with trace identifier to uniquely identify where a single authorisation was obtained covering a number of financial presentments. This is related transaction lifecycle data.

PresentmentSequenceCount.name: Presentment Sequence Count
PresentmentSequenceCount.definition: Expected maximum number of presentments for this transaction. This is related transaction lifecycle data.

AuthenticationToken.name: Authentication Token
AuthenticationToken.definition: Code calculated using an algorithm against key transaction data elements that are common to both authorisation and financial messages. This is related transaction lifecycle data.

LifeCycleIdentificationMissing.name: Life Cycle Identification Missing
LifeCycleIdentificationMissing.definition: Reason for not providing a lifecycle trace identification information.

AcquirerReferenceData.name: Acquirer Reference Data
AcquirerReferenceData.definition: Data supplied by an acquirer in an authorisation or financial request, advice or notification that may be required to be provided in a subsequent transaction.

AcquirerReferenceNumber.name: Acquirer Reference Number
AcquirerReferenceNumber.definition: Data supplied by an acquirer to assist in identifying a transaction (for example, for researching retrievals and chargebacks).

IssuerReferenceData.name: Issuer Reference Data
IssuerReferenceData.definition: Data supplied by a card issuer in an authorisation response, financial response message or in a chargeback transaction that the acquirer may be required to provide in subsequent transactions.
